sentence: This project studies how irradiation and stress make stainless steel crack, using X-ray imaging to watch the process in real time.
This project studies how the calorie intake of mother fruit flies before conception changes how their embryos develop.
This project studies how AI and optimization can help each other, at scale, in chip design, robotics and communication networks.
This project studies how gene expression changes while chickens form muscle and how those changes affect their traits.
This project traces how mammalian chromosomes and the rate at which they exchange information have changed across time.
This project tests ways to use tiny defects in diamond to detect extremely small electric and magnetic fields.
This project buys a scanning probe microscope that combines nanoscale imaging with Raman and photoluminescence spectroscopy.
This project uses genetic engineering to change immune genes in laboratory frogs and tests whether they survive a fungal infection better.
This project develops computational methods and mathematical tools to understand how particles that carry a fraction of an electric charge appear in moiré materials.
This project develops techniques for sharing genomic databases while protecting the privacy of the people whose genomes they contain.
This project uses machine learning to speed up the computations behind metabolic models of microbial communities.
This project studies how approximate solutions to linear partial differential equations converge, and uses neural networks to compute solutions.
This project studies how magnetic stimulation affects myelin, the protective covering of nerve fibers, made by oligodendrocytes.
This project develops a system in corn for placing genes at predetermined sites in the genome and for rapid gene editing.
